## Change requirements

Follow the applicable [contributor checklist](../docs/contributing.md):

- [ ] Engine contract: Decision-log entry/amendment, §9 record, format bump when needed, schemas/goldens/skills
- [ ] Profile: tested rules, rationale, changelog/migration, compatibility review and skill wording; release/tag/snapshot on publication
- [ ] Scope and authority respected; no client data or project-specific vocabulary added
